private_lines.Priya: You teach a prep-to-two class, supervise the playground at recess and lunch, and spend evenings marking and planning; you share a flat with Imogen in Footscray.
private_lines.Ravi: You teach Year 6 full days, coach junior footy on weekends, and do report writing at the kitchen table after dinner; you live alone in a house in Coburg.
private_lines.Imogen: You are in your first years of teaching, planning lessons and learning the ropes with support from Priya; you share a flat with her in Footscray and walk to school when the weather is fine.
private_lines.Warwick: You run the school library, shelve and order books, read to the younger classes, and in the evenings you swim laps at the local pool; you live alone in a Brunswick unit.
private_lines.Kate: You teach a Grade 3 class, run the school choir after hours, and walk your dog around the park in Northcote in the mornings; you live alone in a small house in Northcote.
